text.Jamming Terminal:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 2 Combat and choose a target opponent who must immediately discard a card. 
 Strategy ==
The main asset of this card is its ability to stay in play for long, as it has a high defense and is not an outpost. Especially combined with other cards that force your opponent to discard cards it can quickly become dangerous. It also provides an ally for your Star Empire cards while it is in play, which is important since all other cards in Frontiers that make your opponent discard have ally bonuses. The 2 Combat is not very strong, so in a deck not focused on Star Empire it may not be the best choice for this cost. Although if it stays in play for multiple turns, the total combat can still add up over time, and it does not need allying itself. 

Conclusion: very strong in a deck focused on making the opponent discard, otherwise only useful if you can let it stay in play for multiple turns.
